capabilities: Convert edits into trackable CriticMarkup suggestions
Anchor comment threads to text selections and code blocks
Enforce editing modes per note via frontmatter
Accept or reject suggestions across the vault
Render CriticMarkup in Live Preview and Reading view
extras: Beta fork with 1,100+ automated tests but unfinished live-vault validation. Warns that 0.14 writes only the new attribute-block metadata format, which Commentator and Inkling below 0.13 cannot read, so all collaborators must upgrade first. Also warns that the old plugin id 'inkling' now belongs to an unrelated plugin, so clicking Update on 0.11.x installs replaces it. Mode enforcement is not technical; aimed at high-trust teams.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of Commentator.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to propose edits without applying them, or to anchor review comments to text selections, especially when collaborating on a vault.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of Commentator.

summary: CriticMarkup editor that adds track-changes suggestions, anchored comment threads, and a reviewer comment mode to Obsidian notes.
